g.text: Mute any chat from its menu

ul.li: Nothing reaches YouTube or a linked site from the reader's browser before they click.
A muted chat sends neither push nor email: mute is kept on the Matrix server, not only in the app.
The 10 MB limit is the server's; the app only stops a file earlier with a clearer message.

text.tspan: Muted: no toast, push or email;
